_note: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC breakout module. Pin table audited against Microchip DS22039D. 6-pin module: OUT (analog voltage), GND, VCC, SDA, SCL, A0 (address select). Default I2C address 0x60 (A0 low) or 0x62 (A0 high). Output: vOut = (dacCode/4095) * VCC. First analog-output I2C part in the engine. Params: address (0x60 or 0x62).
